name: Database_Schema_Summary
observations: Database Engine: PostgreSQL 16 ONLY (docker service 'postgres', see AGENTS.md). STRICT RULE: Supabase and MySQL are not used; never use client-side DB SDKs from the browser.
Primary Key convention: id() / bigIncrements (bigint unsigned) in Laravel migrations.

Strict Typing Rule: column id is numeric bigint; never compare bigint columns with string values (do NOT `where('id', $slug)`, PostgreSQL raises 'operator does not exist: bigint = text'). Always distinguish `id` (bigint) from `slug`/`code` (string).
Money representation: unsignedBigInteger for VND / currency amounts without floating point errors.

Total 32 application tables (documented as one entity each): Authentication, Room Multi-tenancy, Campaign Ordering, Debt Settlement, Audit/Security, Notifications, Feedback/Contact, Crawler and System/Room Settings. Laravel framework tables (users, cache, cache_locks, jobs, job_batches, failed_jobs, sessions, password_reset_tokens) are not documented. See entity 'Project_Layout' for file locations.
Core Multi-tenancy: GlobalUser (system-wide identity) -> RoomUser (room-scoped membership with unique user_code) -> Room.
Admin RBAC: AdminAccount (role enum AdminRole: 'admin' | 'superadmin') -> AdminRoom pivot -> Room.
Campaign Lifecycle: draft -> active -> locked -> ordering -> delivering -> completed -> cancelled.
Order State Machine: submitted -> confirmed -> ordering -> ordered -> delivering -> completed -> cancelled.

Order Partial Unique Constraint: Only 1 active order per member per campaign via index `orders_one_active_per_user_campaign` (WHERE status IN ('submitted','confirmed','ordering','ordered','delivering')).
Payment Accounts Partial Unique Constraint: Only 1 default account per room via `payment_accounts_one_default_per_room` (WHERE is_default = true).
Debts: 1 record per (campaign_id, room_user_id) unique pair. Tracks original_amount, sponsor_amount, adjustment_amount, paid_amount, remaining_amount.

name: global_users
observations: Table: global_users (Model: App\Models\GlobalUser).

Relations: hasMany roomUsers, hasMany oauthIdentities, hasMany feedbacks, hasMany userNotifications.

name: oauth_identities
observations: Table: oauth_identities (Model: App\Models\OAuthIdentity).

Columns: id (bigint PK), global_user_id (foreignId -> global_users restrictOnDelete), provider (string), provider_user_id (string), provider_email (string), linked_at (timestamp nullable), last_login_at (timestamp nullable), created_at, updated_at.

name: rooms
observations: Table: rooms (Model: App\Models\Room).

Columns: id (bigint PK), name (string), slug (string unique index), description (text nullable), avatar_url (string nullable), status (string index, default 'active', Enum: RoomStatus), timezone (string, default 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh'), language (string(10), default 'vi'), settings (json nullable), created_at, updated_at.

Relations: hasMany roomUsers, hasMany campaigns, hasMany orders, hasMany debts, hasMany paymentAccounts, hasMany notificationChannels, hasMany roomSettings, belongsToMany adminAccounts (via admin_rooms).

name: room_users
observations: Table: room_users (Model: App\Models\RoomUser).

Columns: id (bigint PK), room_id (foreignId -> rooms restrictOnDelete), global_user_id (foreignId -> global_users restrictOnDelete), user_code (string unique), display_name (string), normalized_name (string index), status (string, default 'active', Enum: RoomUserStatus), joined_at (timestamp), last_active_at (timestamp nullable), created_at, updated_at.
Unique constraints: [room_id, global_user_id], [room_id, user_code], and global user_code.
Relations: belongsTo room, belongsTo globalUser, hasMany devices (room_user_devices), hasMany orders, hasMany debts.

name: room_user_devices

Columns: id (bigint PK), room_user_id (foreignId -> room_users cascadeOnDelete), device_uuid (string index), token_hash (string), verified_at (timestamp nullable), last_seen_at (timestamp nullable), revoked_at (timestamp nullable), created_at, updated_at.

name: admin_accounts

Columns: id (bigint PK), name (string), email (string unique), phone (text nullable), avatar_url (string nullable), department (string nullable), password (string), role (string index, default 'admin', Enum: AdminRole [superadmin, admin]), status (string index, default 'active', Enum: AdminStatus), two_factor_enabled (boolean, default false), last_login_at (timestamp nullable), remember_token, created_at, updated_at.
Relations: belongsToMany rooms (via admin_rooms), hasMany campaigns (as creator_admin_id), hasMany adminNotifications.

name: admin_rooms

Columns: id (bigint PK), admin_id (foreignId -> admin_accounts cascadeOnDelete), room_id (foreignId -> rooms cascadeOnDelete), created_at, updated_at.
Unique constraint on [admin_id, room_id].

name: campaigns

Columns: id (bigint PK), room_id (foreignId -> rooms restrictOnDelete), name (string), code (string(64) unique nullable), restaurant (string), creator_admin_id (foreignId -> admin_accounts nullOnDelete), sponsor_name (string nullable), sponsor_type (string, default 'none', Enum: SponsorType), sponsor_description (text nullable), sponsor_allocations (json nullable), deadline (timestamp nullable), max_budget (unsignedBigInteger nullable), flat_price (unsignedBigInteger nullable), delivery_fee (unsignedBigInteger, default 0), discount (unsignedBigInteger, default 0), payment_account_id (foreignId -> payment_accounts nullOnDelete), description (text nullable), status (string index, default 'draft', Enum: CampaignStatus), started_at (timestamp nullable), closed_at (timestamp nullable), created_at, updated_at.

name: DrinkFlow_Architecture_Rules
observations: Layering: Thin Controllers -> FormRequests -> Action Classes (Single-purpose Business Logic) / Services (Reusable helpers/integrations) -> Eloquent Models.

Controller Namespaces: User Global in `App\Http\Controllers\User\Global\*` (/me/*), Room-Scoped in `App\Http\Controllers\User\*` (/rooms/{room:slug}), Room Admin in `App\Http\Controllers\Admin\*` (/admin/{room:slug}), Superadmin in `App\Http\Controllers\Superadmin\*` (/superadmin/*).
PHP Coding Standard: `declare(strict_types=1);` on every file; complete parameter & return type hinting; PHPDoc blocks on all methods.
Constants & Statuses: Managed via PHP Backed Enums (`App\Enums\*`) or Model constants. No magic strings.
Images: Every `` must have `loading="lazy"`, meaningful alt/multilingual text, and onError fallback.
Views & Layouts: Public views use `<x-public.layout>`, Global views use `<x-global.layout>`, Admin views use `<x-admin.layout>`. No duplicate layout markup.

name: Project_Layout
observations: Laravel 12 (PHP ^8.2) application lives in the src/ subfolder (src/composer.json, src/artisan). Repo root also holds docker-compose.yml, Dockerfile, realtime/ (Node.js Socket.IO gateway), documents/, AGENTS.md, .agents/rules/*.md.
All file paths MUST be relative to the repository root and start with src/ (example: src/app/Http/Controllers/Admin/CampaignController.php).

Routes: src/routes/{web,user,admin,superadmin,console}.php. Room-admin routes live in src/routes/admin.php (URL prefix /admin/{room:slug}); campaign routes there: /campaigns, /campaigns/create, /campaigns/{campaign}/edit, /campaigns/{campaign}/info, /campaigns/{campaign}/orders, /campaigns/{campaign}/export/{dataset} (App\Http\Controllers\Admin\CampaignController).

Views: src/resources/views/{admin,components,emails,errors,public,superadmin,user}. Admin campaign views: src/resources/views/admin/{campaigns,campaign-create,campaign-detail,campaign-edit,campaign-info,campaign-live,campaign-orders}.blade.php; admin layout: src/resources/views/admin/layout.blade.php.
Frontend assets: src/resources/js/{admin,global,public,room,shared,superadmin}/ plus admin.js, app.js, global.js, public.js, room.js; src/resources/css/{admin,app,global,public,room,superadmin}.css.
Translations: src/lang/{vi,en,ja} - every new UI or validation key must be added to all three languages.
Tests: docker exec drinkflow-new-app-1 php artisan test (must be 100% green).
